summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of ALBARKA iteration 5 (8 scenarios requested). Real OTP UI login validated (dev_otp read from the amber 'Mode pilote' card, typed in the shadcn InputOTP, redirect to /admin + albarka_token stored). All iteration-5 features validated end-to-end through the public preview URL: Paramètres→Signature (certificate create 'Cabinet TEST' → shown 'Actif' → delete), Paramètres→Branding (1x1 PNG upload on kind 'logo' → listed with size/date → 'Appliquer' switch toggle persisted via PUT /admin/branding/toggles → delete), Rapports client→Modèles (create 'Test modèle standard' with is_default → star displayed → edit rename → delete), Rapports client→Rapports (client select, generate dialog exposes 'Modèle de rapport' dropdown with 'Modèle par défaut' + templates, 'Ponctuel' report generated for current month and appears in list), Contacts→Par client (sub-tabs Contacts/Groupes present, group 'Direction TEST' created with 0 members then deleted), Contacts→Importer CSV (template CSV download starts, modal closes, real CSV upload imported 1 contact and appears in list), Send-to-group (send dialog shows 'Ou envoyer à des groupes' with the created group, checkbox checkable, direct 'to' input correctly disabled when a group is selected). No console errors, no 4xx/5xx observed. All test data cleaned up.

issues: No real thumbnail preview of the uploaded image: a generic grey ImageIcon placeholder is shown instead. The helper previewUrl(kind) is defined but never used (dead code) — consider fetching the authenticated image as a blob URL for a true preview.

Deleting the currently active certificate leaves the cabinet with zero active certificates (remaining cert stays 'Inactif') with no warning; PDF signing would then fail until an admin manually re-activates one. Suggest a confirm warning or auto-activation fallback.

action_items: Optional: render a real image thumbnail in BrandingPanel (or remove the unused previewUrl helper).
Optional: warn (or auto-activate a fallback) when the active signing certificate is deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandingPanel.jsx: `tokenCache`/`setTokenCache` state and `previewUrl()` are unused dead code — remove or wire up for previews.

Report numbering uses a deterministic slug + 4-char tenant hash (RAP-AMINATA35D6-...); older reports in the DB use the legacy slug (RAP-AMINATA-...), so historical numbering is inconsistent — expected, but worth noting for the client.
seed_data_creation: Temporary data created and fully removed during testing: certificate 'Cabinet TEST', branding logo tiny.png, report templates 'Test modèle standard'/'v2', contact groups 'Direction TEST' & 'Direction TEST QA', imported contact 'TEST Import Un'. One extra 'Ponctuel' report (RAP-AMINATA35D6-PONCTUEL-202609-0001) was left in place for Traoré BTP SARL as proof of generation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP UI login works: the shadcn InputOTP element itself carries data-testid='otp-input' (it IS the <input>), so click it and page.keyboard.type(code) — there are no per-digit inputs matching '[data-testid="otp-input"] input'. dev_otp digits can be extracted from [data-testid='dev-otp-hint'] text. Faster path: set localStorage 'albarka_token' with a JWT obtained from /api/auth/login + /api/auth/verify-otp then navigate to /admin/*. All delete actions use window.confirm → register page.on('dialog', accept). Iteration-5 UI is fully functional; next focus could be PDF content verification (branding applied, template intro/conclusion) and the pyHanko signing flow.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in iteration 5 frontend.
